name: styles_with_nonzero
expr: len([s for s in doc.StyleFamilies.getByName('ParagraphStyles').ElementNames if doc.StyleFamilies.getByName('ParagraphStyles').getByName(s).ParaHyphenationMaxLeadingChars != 0 or doc.StyleFamilies.getByName('ParagraphStyles').getByName(s).ParaHyphenationMaxTrailingChars != 0])
